messages.subject: Calderdale House, Manchester — title and pre-contract package
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Alistair,

We act for Ellwood Estates Partners Limited on the purchase of Calderdale House. Please could you let us have the draft contract, official copies for title GM428193, the three occupational leases, the 1999 deed of easement, the Castleford rent deposit deed and replies to CPSE.1. We are running searches in parallel.

We are working to a 7 March exchange — grateful for the package this week.

Kind regards,
Elena Marchetti
Whitfield Carter LLP

—
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Elena,

Thank you. Nadia is uploading the title pack, leases, the 1999 easement and the rent deposit deed to the data room today; the access link follows under separate cover. The draft contract and CPSE replies will follow by the end of the week. We note your timetable and will do our best to keep to it.

One point: our client will want the contract to reflect a TOGC and a full title guarantee. More to follow.

Regards,
Alistair Whitlock
Pemberton Rowe LLP

Best,
Nadia
